skill.summary: Analyze YouTube thumbnails for visual hierarchy, color impact, text clarity, emotional appeal, and competitor benchmarking to optimize click-through rates.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of YouTube Thumbnail Analyzer.
- Provides structured analysis of thumbnail design, focusing on visual hierarchy, color psychology, text optimization, emotional impact, and design best practices.
- Enables detailed competitor comparison, summary action items, and quick-win recommendations.
- Includes clear scoring criteria and example output format.
- Designed for YouTubers, video marketers, and content creators aiming to maximize click-through rates.
